headline: Executive order sets up a White House initiative focused on education and economic opportunity for Hispanic Americans.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order creates or continues a White House initiative aimed at improving education and economic opportunity for Hispanic people in the United States. No summary was provided, so the specific programs, offices, or duties it sets up are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The initiative is meant to focus federal attention on their educational and economic opportunities.
They may be asked to take part in or support the initiative's work.
